title: Child's Growth and Independence (2-3 Years)
description: A journey to support the child's independence between the ages of two and three: gradual toilet training, developing language and cognition through imaginative play, based on reliable tarbiyah (upbringing) and developmental references.

review_defects.arabic: استناداً إلى مراجع تربوية وتنموية موثوقة
review_defects.english: based on reliable tarbiyah (upbringing) and developmental references
review_defects.why: The Arabic adjective 'تربوية' (educational) is rendered as the noun 'tarbiyah' with a parenthetical, introducing an explicit Islamic term not present in the source.
